Case: Verification screen is displayed with masked email and 6-digit code input after signup
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed signup (email + password) but has not yet verified their email. Auth0 redirects to app.sleekflow.io with error=access_denied&error_description=You need to first verify the email.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-006 · AC1]
  • Traceability: "Confirm your email address" at app.sleekflow.io: masked email display; 6-digit code input (inputmode=numeric, autocomplete=one-time-code).
Test Steps:
1. Complete signup flow with a new email address.
  2. Observe that Auth0 redirects back to app.sleekflow.io with the error_description indicating email verification is required.
  3. Inspect the resulting page.
  4. Inspect the code input field attributes.
Expected:
• Page heading reads "Confirm your email address".
  • The registered email address is displayed in masked format (e.g., j***@example.com).
  • A single 6-digit code input field is present with inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" attributes.
BDD: Given a new user has completed signup and not verified email, When Auth0 redirects back to app.sleekflow.io, Then the email verification screen is shown with masked email and a 6-digit numeric code input

Case: Email is verified and user proceeds to company setup when a valid 6-digit code is submitted
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the email verification screen at app.sleekflow.io. A valid verification code has been sent to the registered email.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-006 · AC1]
  • Traceability: 6-digit code input (inputmode=numeric, autocomplete=one-time-code) or email link verification.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the email verification screen.
  2. Retrieve the 6-digit code from the registered email inbox.
  3. Enter the valid 6-digit code into the code input field.
  4. Submit the code (press Enter or click the submit button).
  5. Observe the resulting navigation.
Expected:
• Email verification succeeds with no error message.
  • User is redirected to the company setup page (/en/register-company).
BDD: Given a user is on the email verification screen with a valid code in hand, When the user enters the correct 6-digit code and submits, Then the email is verified and the user is redirected to company setup
